dct_description_sm:
Type: Note: Notes:

Variables included in the data file are as follows:

  • First 3 columns are the PIT tag codes for implanted snakes. The 10-digit code is broken into 3 columns for convenience. Only the last 4 digits were used to ID snakes in field notes etc.
  • Brand indicates subcaudal scale marks used prior to or in conjunction with PIT tags.
  • Sex is the snake's sex.
  • Cap# is the number of different years the snake has been captured in
  • Cap## is the number of captures within a year. A=1st capture that year, B=2nd capture in that year, ...
  • Year, Month and day give the date of each capture
  • Total is the snakes total length measured by running a string along its belly from the snout to the tail tip.
  • Tail is measured on a ruler from the vent to the tip.
  • SVL is a simple calculation = Total - Tail.
  • Mass is mass in grams measured with a pesola with the snake in a bag.
  • FFWM (fat-free wet mass) aand %fat are calculated from a formula given in Weatherhead and Brown CJZ 1996,
  • Estage is age estimated from SVL from a formula in Brown, G.P. and P.J. Weatherhead.1999. Growth and sexual size dimorphism in northern water snakes, Nerodia sipedon. Copeia 1999: 722-731.
  • S ite BB=Barb's Marsh (44 31'25.52"N 76 22'25.60"W), BV=Beaver Marsh (44 31'22.65"N 76 23'17.87"W)
;

These are long-term capture/recapture and morphometric data for northern watersnakes (Nerodia sipedon) from two sites at QUBS: Barb's Marsh (44 31'25.52"N 76 22'25.60"W), Beaver Marsh (44 31'22.65"N 76 23'17.87"W). These data were collected as part of the doctoral thesis of Greg Brown, under supervision of Pat Weatherhead, then of Carleton University. Pat Weatherhead and Greg Brown share IP rights on these.
